title: Missing ceramic ring
detail: A component is skipped when the candidate frame is drawn.

title: Changed material
detail: One component picks up a different material while the camera stays fixed.

title: Displaced part
detail: A translation changes the position of a single part.

title: Routine exposure drift
detail: A gain change affects the whole frame. The geometry stays put.

title: Subpixel camera drift
detail: The camera shifts slightly across the entire frame.

title: A real false alarm
detail: A held-out camera shift crosses the learned threshold. The aligned baseline accepts it. Test pair 275-jitter.

title: A baseline miss
detail: A held-out material change slips below the baseline threshold. The learned detector flags it. Test pair 274-material.

title: Minnen camera projection
detail: The same grove passes through Minnen’s Haxe camera with curvature enabled and disabled. Both captures use original fixture artwork. This pair is outside the training family.
